LIMITER = over-unrolling re-injecting noise (the itnet_v2 mechanism), now evidenced by iter-6. vn_T 5->2 cuts the in-loop PYRO-NN projector DC re-anchoring from 5 to 2 -> less noisy-LD-adjoint re-injection, letting the 16-filter learned regulariser/denoiser dominate. HYPOTHESIS: with fewer DC steps val_ssim jumps PAST the 0.81 FBP-adjacent floor toward/over the ~0.84 LD-FBP floor and hr clears 0 (mirroring itnet_v2 itnet_k 3->1). FALSIFIER (terminal): if val_ssim <= ~0.81 / hr 0 even at reduced vn_T=2, hammernik_vn is CONFIRMED structurally FBP-bounded on rebinned 2304-view Mayo LDCT -- depth-DOWN was the last family-proven lever -- FILE THE NEGATIVE VERDICT and drive remaining iters to DOCUMENT the ceiling. BUDGET (HARD 20-min/1200s train+score; sbatch --time=00:30:00): vn_T=2 = 0.4x iter-6 per-step DC+RBF cost and 0.4x iter-5 vn_T=5 cost -> FASTER; at train_n=480 with ~2 unrolled steps the per-ep cost drops sharply so max_train_s=1000 still binds with MORE epochs (>3 convergence point -> fair converged comparison). val_n=214 kept. Total well under the 1800s SLURM kill, large margin. MEMORY-SAFE: vn_T=2 x N_k=16 with batch_size=2 + vn_checkpoint=true is the LIGHTEST footprint yet (fewer unrolled steps -> less activation memory; far from the hammernik_2017 bs=4 OOM at 72s). grad_clip=1.0 + vn_dc_norm=true retained (VN-family NaN-skip stability; the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint overflows the backward otherwise).
